summary: Ansh Mehra is a New Delhi-based founder of The Cutting Edge School, specializing in enterprise AI training and agentic AI enablement. With a background in UX design and marketing at companies like Swiggy and Zuddl, he has pivoted to building an educational brand with significant reach (500K+ YouTube, 346K+ Instagram). He is an active international traveler who blends high-end cultural tourism with professional networking, representing India in global AI championships.
